# How to Find Internships: a Teen Guide for the US and Vancouver

> A free, open-source guide for teens ages 12 to 18 in the US and Vancouver, BC. It lists real internships, paid youth programs, research, volunteering and job shadowing, with the deadlines that could be confirmed, the work-permit rules, and a message a teen can send to ask an adult for a chance.

For each program the guide's writers opened the program's own website where it could be read, and wrote down the age rule, pay, dates and how to apply in their own words, with the date the page was last read. Programs that need the applicant to be 18 or a college student, that were discontinued, or that charge a lot to promise an "internship" are left out. The site has no sign-up, no ads and no tracking. The program data and written guides are under CC BY 4.0, and the code is under the MIT license. Credit line: "Teen Internship Guide by Kentaro Vadney and contributors, https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/". Deadlines and rules change, so check the program's official page before relying on a date.

## Start here

- [Home](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/): what the guide is and where to begin
- [Program data as CSV](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/data/entries.csv): every program, one row each, CC BY 4.0

## Pages

- [Programs for High Schoolers Across the US and Vancouver](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/find.html): Search every paid youth program, internship, research program, volunteer spot and shadowing option we could verify for teens in many states and Vancouver, BC
- [Map of Teen Programs: Every City in This Guide](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/map.html): Every city with a teen job, internship or volunteer program in this guide, on one map of the US and Vancouver, BC
- [The Playbook: Write the Message That Gets a Yes](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/playbook.html): Build your people map, write a five-line message, send it, follow up, and turn a yes into a real opportunity
- [Your First Resume: One Page, No Experience Needed](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/resume.html): What goes on a first resume, how to turn babysitting, clubs and volunteering into strong bullets, and a free builder that prints to PDF
- [Get Ready for Your First Job: Permit, Papers, Pay and a Ride](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/ready.html): A checklist for teens in many states and Vancouver, BC: how to get a work permit at your school, which papers to bring, how pay and paycheck forms work, and free or cheap rides to work
- [Jobs That Hire Teens: Minimum Ages at Real Employers](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/jobs.html): Which employers hire teens at 14, 15, 16 and up, in plain words
- [Do I Need a Work Permit? Pick Your Job and Get the Exact Steps](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/permit.html): Pick your state, age and work to see if you need a work permit, who issues it and what to bring
- [Work Rules in Your Language: Official Translations](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/languages.html): Official Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Vietnamese, Tagalog and Ukrainian pages on teen work rules, the W-4, wages and job scams, from federal, California, Georgia, New York and Illinois agencies
- [Apply and Interview: Practice Questions, References, Thank-You](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/interview.html): A free prep sheet for a first job: plan your hours by age, practice 12 common questions, line up references, write a thank-you note
- [What Opens When: A Month by Month Calendar of Teen Programs](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/calendar.html): See when teen jobs, internships and volunteer programs take applications
- [Too Young for a Job? Ages 12 to 14: Earn, Learn and Start Something](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/younger.html): What a 12 to 14 year old can do for money in California, Georgia, New York and Illinois, safety training for sitters, which apps are 18 and over, groups that teach business skills, and how to get ready for a first job at 14
- [For Parents: Work Permits, Money, Safety and How to Help](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/parents.html): What a parent or guardian of a 12 to 17 year old needs in one place: the work permit forms by state, official pages in other languages, how to help without doing it for your teen, first paycheck and savings facts, and scam and safe contact warnings
- [Handout for teachers and counselors](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/handout.html): One printable page for a teacher or counselor to hand to teens: the guide address, a QR code, a three step path and what the guide is not
- [Your First Paycheck: What Comes Out and Tax Forms by State](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/paycheck.html): Estimate what a first paycheck looks like in California, Georgia, New York and Illinois using only sourced numbers, understand the W-4 and state withholding forms, and learn how to get unpaid wages
- [Safe at Work: Your Rights, Off-Limits Jobs, Who to Call](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/safety.html): What official pages say about safe work for teens: your right to a safe workplace, jobs under 18 may not do, harassment, injuries and workers' compensation, punishment for speaking up, and phone numbers to call
- [Share This Guide](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/share.html): Copy a link or print a QR code for the guide
- [The Numbers: What Is Out There for Teens](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/insights.html): Charts built from the real list of teen programs: what is open now, how your age changes your options, where the paid work is, and what kinds of programs exist
- [Teen Work Rules in California: Permits, Hours, Pay, Safety](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/rules.html): Plain-language answers on work permits, hours by age, minimum wage, unpaid internships, wage theft, scams, LinkedIn age limits and safe contact with adults
- [Teen Work Rules in Georgia, New York, Illinois and 13 More States](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/states.html): Plain-language summary of work permits, hours, minimum wage and who to call for teens in Georgia, New York, Illinois and 13 more states and British Columbia, from official state and federal pages
- [Help Build This: Add a Program, Fix a Link, Put It on Your Resume](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/contribute.html): This guide is open source and run with student help
- [About This Guide: Who Made It, How We Checked, Your Privacy](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/about.html): Who made the teen internship guide, how every program was checked, what we do and do not promise, and how your privacy is protected
